description:
One defined term across the whole corpus: each distinct WORDING with the publisher's own text and the instruments that write it, every instrument that borrows it (with the chain of acts it passes through), the instruments that cite a defining provision, and the term's labels in the act's other authentic EU languages. Ask this when a term is defined differently in different instruments ('producer' under WEEE, the Batteries Regulation and the PPWR) and the answer depends on which. Each instrument carries `pivotWhy`: why the term matters in THAT act ('carries 38 duties · 6 other definitions build on it').

Meanings are separated on facts only: identical words are grouped, different words are listed apart, and a borrowing is attached to what the borrowing act names. Never state that two different wordings mean the same thing on the strength of this tool. A query by a borrower's own label (an alias) returns the family it borrows into.

The definitions and defining instruments are free. The borrowing chains and citations are Lexiara Nexus data requiring an API key on a signed-in account; without one the arrays are empty and `gated` says how many were withheld.

term.description: The defined term, e.g. 'producer'. Matched exactly (case-insensitive).
